meta.name: Fears of a Clown
meta.description: Everybody is now horrified of clowns after Bart's prank using clown masks, which also causes  Krusty to lose his job. He attempts a comeback as a dramatic actor in the play "The Salesman's Bad Day", with Llewellyn Sinclair as his director.
